shim.name: datadog-lambda-js
shim.origin: Packed compiled dist from the pre-migration PR842 checkout used in the 2026-09-25 compatibility audit; not repacked on each run.

limitations: The frozen shim is a locally packed release-candidate checkout, not a separately downloaded published shim tarball.
Candidate dependencies resolve at install time; each generated lockfile is retained. Default control dependencies use the frozen lock.
Installation uses --ignore-scripts; optional native install behavior is not certified.
Runtime image IDs and architecture are recorded, not assumed immutable from tags.
No goldens, real AWS deployment/termination/HTTP streaming, Datadog ingestion, or AppSec/profiler certification.
